summary_en: Brother Industries raised interim dividend to 60 yen per share from 50 yen, and revised full-year FY2027 dividend forecast to 120 yen per share from 100 yen, reflecting solid performance and commitment to stable shareholder returns under medium-term strategy CS B2027.
title_en: Notice regarding dividend payment (dividend increase) and revision of year-end dividend forecast
translation_en_brief:
Brother Industries announced a dividend increase for fiscal year 2027 ending March 31, 2027. The interim dividend per share was raised to 60 yen from the previously announced 50 yen, and the full-year dividend forecast was revised upward to 120 yen per share from 100 yen. The total interim dividend payment amounts to 14.815 billion yen, with an ex-dividend date of September 30, 2026, and effective date of December 3, 2026.

The company operates under a medium-term strategy called CS B2027, which commenced in fiscal 2025. The strategy establishes a floor of 100 yen per share for annual dividends and targets a payout ratio of approximately 40%, while investing in growth. Within this framework, the board decided to increase both the interim and year-end dividends by 10 yen each as a supplementary shareholder return reflecting business performance and cash flow conditions. This dividend increase aligns with the company's fundamental policy of providing stable and continuous shareholder returns while securing necessary retained earnings for future growth.
